name: La Bible de l'Épée
statement: This Bible is in the Public Domain.

evidence.quote: LA BIBLE DE L'ÉPÉE édition TULIPE, 2005 … This Bible is in the Public Domain.

verification.note: A 2005 revision (édition T.U.L.I.P.E.) of the Calvin/Ostervald/Martin text adjusted to the King James. Only a distributor calls it public domain; no statement from the editor or publisher was found, and a 2005 revision is protected unless its makers released it.
